evals.prompt: Buatkan dashboard admin untuk SDN Purwantoro 1: jumlah siswa per rombel, status kelengkapan data Dapodik, dan daftar siswa yang datanya masih kurang. Satu file HTML.
evals.expected_output: The eight-line Brief (Direction names its sources) is written first; a token block in :root; one lead region (the list of incomplete records) instead of 4 cards + 2 charts; interface text in Indonesian; empty/loading/error states exist; slopscan reports 0 errors. The report lists render.py PNGs under LOOKED with defects seen and fixed.
assertions: slopscan exit code 0
contains :root custom properties
no emoji in markup
html lang=id
an empty state exists
prefers-reduced-motion handled or no motion used
report has a LOOKED section with render.py PNG paths

evals.prompt: Ini landing page hasil AI, kelihatan generik banget. Tolong perbaiki tanpa mengubah isi dan urutan section. (lampirkan evals/fixtures/slop-landing.html)
evals.expected_output: Repair mode: findings with file:line, then the Brief, then the rewritten file; sections and their order unchanged; unverifiable claims are raised with the user, not invented.
assertions: slopscan errors drop to 0
section count and order unchanged
report lists unverified claims under OPEN
no new gradient/glass/bento trend introduced
report has a LOOKED section with before/after render.py PNG paths

evals.prompt: Review saja, jangan diubah: apakah form update data wali murid ini sudah layak dipakai di HP orang tua?
evals.expected_output: Review mode: no file is modified; ranked findings with the exact fix; covers labels, 44px touch targets, the pending state of google.script.run calls, and language.
assertions: no files modified
findings have severity and exact fix
mentions touch target size
mentions pending/error state for server calls
findings cite what the render.py PNGs show at a named width

evals.prompt: Buat dua halaman depan, masing-masing satu file HTML: (a) portal pendaftaran siswa baru SMP negeri di Wonosobo untuk orang tua di HP, (b) dashboard antrean servis bengkel motor untuk mekanik di layar meja. Kerjakan terpisah, seolah dua klien berbeda.
evals.expected_output: Two Briefs whose Voice, Origin, Density, and Direction differ and cite different sources; the pages differ in font pairing, accent hue, density, and structure; neither copies a domain-recipe-matrix row whole; each report shows render.py PNGs at 320/768/1440 with defects seen and fixed.
assertions: the two pages load different font families
the two accent colours differ by more than 60 degrees of hue or one page has no accent
(a) is single-column at 320px with targets of 44px or more; (b) shows at least 8 queue rows above the fold at 1440px
neither page uses a font pair and theme copied unchanged from domain-recipe-matrix.md
each report has a LOOKED section with render.py PNG paths
slopscan exit code 0 on both files

evals.prompt: Buatkan landing page untuk koperasi simpan pinjam petani kopi di Temanggung.
evals.expected_output: Derives type and colour from the Origin (coffee co-op documents, local signage); does not ship a saturated default font without an Origin reason; slopscan shows no default-font warning or justifies it.
assertions: names a typeface source from the Origin
no Inter/Space Grotesk/Geist/Plus Jakarta Sans/Poppins without a stated product-specific reason
no sparkle icons, blur blobs, or glass over blobs
DECISIONS lists the font reason
slopscan run with default-font addressed
